# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: USA gulf on actions — event hooks.
## COLDWAR | Iraq 1970. Generated by tools/iraq_1970/compile.py.

on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			IRQ = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes }
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_irq_daily = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_campaign = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { tag = USA }
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_usa_daily = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { tag = IRQ }
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_irq_daily = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_capitulation = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					ROOT = { tag = IRQ COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes }
				}
				IRQ = {
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recent_defeat days = 180 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
